name: 01-success-recorded-inputs
demonstrates: The inputs the capability was recorded with.

name: 02-success-different-inputs
demonstrates: A different member, account and reason through the same artifact.

name: 03-outcome-member-not-found
demonstrates: A legitimate answer: no such member. Not an error.

name: 04-outcome-check-already-cleared
demonstrates: A legitimate answer: the check has cleared and cannot be stopped.

name: 05-outcome-account-restricted
demonstrates: A legitimate answer: the operator may not service this member.

name: 06-recovered-session-expired
demonstrates: The session times out mid-flow; the run signs back in and restarts.

name: 07-recovered-system-notice
demonstrates: An interstitial appears over the working pane and is dismissed.

name: 08-failed-checkpoint
demonstrates: The click works and the page settles, but it is not the confirmation screen. Without a checkpoint this would report success.

name: 09-drift-tolerated-by-fallback
demonstrates: The submit control is renamed. Role and name no longer match; the recorded selector finds the same control.

name: 10-unrecognised-state
demonstrates: A blocking dialog no condition declares. Never treated as success.

name: 11-refused-confirmation-required
demonstrates: Attended, with nobody available: the irreversible step is not taken.

name: 12-rejected-bad-input
demonstrates: Arguments that do not satisfy the contract, refused before the browser opens.

name: 13-handover-operator-approves
demonstrates: The run stops at the irreversible step and waits. A separate operator process takes the live session, approves, and hands it back; the run revalidates and completes.
